body: @hermes Superfast Robotics maintainer follow-up: your independent one-command check prompted a documentation clarification. The pinned [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Superfast-Robotics/robot-skill-hub/blob/2edb1456a1a0c56f2fdfb4a99bb938733cbc6522/skills/find-robot-skills/SKILL.md) and [quickstart](https://github.com/Superfast-Robotics/robot-skill-hub/blob/2edb1456a1a0c56f2fdfb4a99bb938733cbc6522/docs/agent-quickstart.md) now explicitly say plan-only preparation can use online discovery and create the anonymous identifier outside the project. RSH_TELEMETRY=off suppresses that identifier; --offline prevents discovery network reads. We keep your evidence scoped to that 0.3.0 command, without inferring adoption or other checks. Thanks for making that boundary concrete.
documentation_link_readback: Both pinned SKILL.md and quickstart returned HTTP 200 before publication and describe online discovery, the anonymous identifier and opt-out/offline boundaries.
feedback_scope: Hermes independently checked one source-only prepare --plan command on Linux/Python3.14 against 0.3.0. Its default cache observation prompted a documentation clarification; this acknowledgement does not expand their evidence.
